## 06 – Remediation (owner: Vishwa)
Backend → `POST /webhook/remediation` (HMAC signed) → verify signature, time window, nonce → **backend start** (`start_playbook_run` only succeeds for an APPROVED run) → fixed branch per action → **backend complete** → 07 Recovery Check.
Never executes commands from the webhook or the AI. `REMEDIATION_EXECUTION_MODE`: `disabled` (default) refuses before the run is started; `executor` sends a signed `POST /v1/execute` { action, service_name, playbook_run_id } to the playbook executor (Keshan, `infrastructure/playbooks/executor`); `simulate` records a clearly marked simulated result for tests.

nodes.name: Remediation webhook
nodes.notes: POST /webhook/remediation. Raw Body ON: the signature covers the exact bytes.

nodes.name: Verify signature and payload
nodes.notes: HMAC-SHA256, 300 s window, nonce once (static data), strict body.

nodes.name: Respond rejected
nodes.notes: 401 bad signature / 409 replay / 400 bad body / 503 not configured.

nodes.name: Execution available?
nodes.notes: executor or simulate. disabled (default, or executor not configured) → refuse before the run is started.

assignments.name: response
assignments.value: ={{ { accepted: false, message: "Remediation execution is not available (REMEDIATION_EXECUTION_MODE is disabled or the executor is not configured). The run was not started." } }}

nodes.name: Backend: start run
nodes.notes: POST /api/machine/playbook-runs/:id/start → start_playbook_run (approval enforced in the database).

nodes.name: Check start result
nodes.notes: Uses the action_type returned by the DATABASE.

nodes.name: Execute: restart
nodes.notes: executor: signs POST /v1/execute { action, service_name, playbook_run_id }. simulate: marked simulated result. No shell commands.

nodes.name: Execute: rollback
nodes.notes: executor: signs POST /v1/execute { action, service_name, playbook_run_id }. simulate: marked simulated result. No shell commands.

nodes.name: Execute: scale
nodes.notes: executor: signs POST /v1/execute { action, service_name, playbook_run_id }. simulate: marked simulated result. No shell commands.

nodes.name: Execute: circuit_breaker
nodes.notes: executor: signs POST /v1/execute { action, service_name, playbook_run_id }. simulate: marked simulated result. No shell commands.

nodes.name: Call executor?
nodes.notes: executor mode → call the executor; simulate / refused → complete directly.

nodes.name: Executor: execute
nodes.notes: POST {EXECUTOR_URL}/v1/execute (HMAC with EXECUTOR_SIGNING_SECRET). Timeout EXECUTOR_TIMEOUT_MS (90 s). Never retried automatically.

nodes.name: Check executor result
nodes.notes: executed: true → success; anything else → failed. Request data is never copied.

nodes.name: Unsupported or rejected action
nodes.notes: Completes the run as failed. Nothing is executed.

nodes.name: Respond refused
nodes.notes: Backend refused (not approved / not found) or mismatch.

nodes.name: Started but mismatched?
nodes.notes: A started run must be completed (as failed).

nodes.name: Sign complete request
nodes.notes: Signs every attempt again: a new nonce per attempt (N-1).

nodes.name: Backend: complete run
nodes.notes: POST /api/machine/playbook-runs/:id/complete (same n8n_execution_id).

nodes.name: Check completion
nodes.notes: Retry on timeout / connection error / 5xx (max 3 attempts); never on 4xx.

nodes.name: Retry completion?
nodes.notes: true → wait (2 s, 4 s) and sign a new request.

nodes.name: Wait before completion retry
nodes.notes: COMPLETE_RETRY_BASE_SECONDS x 2^(attempt-1)

nodes.name: Check recovery?
nodes.notes: Only after a reported success.

nodes.name: Run 07 Recovery Check
nodes.notes: Recovery verification (Tharindu).

nodes.name: Soft failure?
nodes.notes: Set by the nodes before: completion failed after retries, start unconfirmed, AI unavailable, result not stored.

nodes.name: Report soft failure
nodes.notes: One redacted notification per kind of failure (no request data).

nodes.name: Notify error handler (09)
nodes.notes: Runs 09 ("When called with a soft failure"): Slack/Discord when ERROR_NOTIFY_WEBHOOK_URL is set.
